SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND f."Low Grade" = 'K' AND f."High Grade" = '8' AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types') as schools_with_multiple_provisions,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.City) FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE f."Low Grade" = 'K' AND f."High Grade" = '8') as num_cities_offering_k8,
  s.City,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) as school_count_per_city
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."Low Grade" = 'K' AND f."High Grade" = '8'
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY s.City;
